gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: Exact ZIPs ran with zero invalid actions; measured import/create, reset, act latency, and RSS were within local limits.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Launch activated 120 times, early steering 107 times, bend braking 121 times, and straight boost zero times across 12 fresh tune cells.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Both arms finished 11/12 matched tune cells, but candidate median finished lap was 27.32 s versus control 27.28 s; no speed improvement. Collisions, damage and invalid actions were zero.
